set.pl: N part of NE¼ NE¼ sec. 1 T7N R9E, just east of the golf links at Maple Bluff, Madison north side (c.1915 plat)
pinev: c.1915 Hixson Dane County plat shows the Roth 20 acres in the N part of NE¼ NE¼ sec. 1 T7N R9E, just east of the golf links (about 250 m).
set.tovw: Lead grade B: two accounts, unrecovered, plat parcel (treasure thread)
set.st: Matthew Roth, over 80, died in Sept 1907 on his farm near the golf grounds on the Mendota road. About 1905 the family dug up rotten paper money he had hidden, but a jar of gold that he lifted from under the barn floor was hidden again by him and never found; relatives searched for about $3,000. The farm is now a residential neighbourhood on Madison's north side: look-only.

src: Hixson, Plat Book of Dane County, Wisconsin (c.1915)
